assessment.non_circularity: The known-answer battery checks the engine against results derived INDEPENDENTLY of the tortuous-path argument: Maxwell's 1873 dilute-sphere permeability (solved from Laplace's equation, no tortuosity assumption) which Nielsen must reproduce exactly at a=1 (KA2); an exact algebraic identity for the Cussler tortuosity (KA3); and the orientation-limit reductions of Bharadwaj to Cussler (S=1) and to pure volume exclusion (S=-0.5) (KA4/KA5). A negative control (KA11) confirms the tortuosity term contributes a large, non-trivial barrier improvement beyond mere volume exclusion. No check uses the engine to validate itself circularly.
assessment.what_this_is: A verbatim-sourced, parameter-free geometric barrier-improvement engine for flake/lamellar-pigmented marine anti-corrosion films, with engine correctness validated to machine precision against independent analytic results. This is the defining physics of glass-flake / MIO / graphene marine barrier primers and directly serves amphora-barrier-corrosion-score.

barrier_tortuosity_axis.founder_ask: To move this axis from ENGINE_READY to precision-validated: a rights-clean (CC-BY or owned) dataset of >=8 epoxy(-amine) coating specimens, each with independently-measured filler volume fraction, effective in-film aspect ratio (SEM/image analysis or PSD), and measured O2/H2O permeability of both neat and filled film. Enables non-circular precision validation, model selection (Nielsen vs Cussler vs Bharadwaj), and an orientation-parameter S fit.

reference_nominal_application.caveat: REFERENCE_NOMINAL geometry only. Nielsen is strictly valid for phi<0.01 (dilute); marine loadings phi~0.1-0.25 are semidilute -> Cussler/Bharadwaj apply. Effective in-film aspect ratio (post-application, after flake fracture and imperfect alignment) is a MEASURED input (SEM/PSD), typically well below the supplier nominal. Models assume impermeable, non-interacting, monodisperse platelets and ignore interfacial free-volume change, percolation, and film defects/cracks (the dominant real coating failure mode). BIF is therefore a geometric transport estimate, not a corrosion or service-life prediction; measured EIS remains required (module claim-lock).

barrier_tortuosity_axis.target_capability: geometric barrier-improvement (permeability reduction) from lamellar/flake pigment tortuosity in marine anti-corrosion epoxy films

models.bharadwaj_2001: Pr = (1-phi)/[1 + ((2/3)a*phi + (a*phi)^2/9)*(2/3)(S+1/2)] ; S in [-0.5,1], S=1 perpendicular(max tortuosity), S=0 random, S=-0.5 parallel(no tortuosity)
models.maxwell_1873_independent_anchor: Pr = (1-phi)/(1+phi/2) ; dilute impermeable spheres; Nielsen(a=1) must reproduce this
